# Load data
```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")

# Canonical
canonical <- readRDS("./data/carbapenem_resistance_panel/carbapenem_resistance_panel_matrix.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,canonical)

# tn4401 data
tn4401 <- readRDS("./data/TETyper/TETyper_curated.RDS")  
df <- left_join(df,tn4401)

# load the kleborate
kleborate <- readRDS("./data/kleborate/kleborate_curated.RDS") %>% as.data.frame
df <- left_join(df,kleborate) 

# KPC Plasmids 
KPC_info_plasmids <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_plasmids_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame
KPC_info_clusters <- readRDS("./data/KPC_plasmid/KPC_containing_clusters_mat.RDS") %>% as.data.frame 
KPC_containing_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="KPC Plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame%>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
KPC_clusters <- colnames(KPC_containing_clusters)
Non_KPC_clusters <- KPC_info_clusters %>% `colnames<-`(paste0(colnames(.),"_non_KPC")) %>% {ifelse(.=="Non-KPC plasmid",1,0)} %>% as.data.frame %>% select_if(colSums(.)>0)
df <- left_join(df,KPC_containing_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))) %>% left_join(Non_KPC_clusters %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.)))  
df$KPC_plasmid <- lapply(df$isolate_no,FUN=function(x){
  KPC_containing_clusters[rownames(KPC_containing_clusters) == x,] %>% select_if(colSums(.)>0) %>% colnames() %>% {ifelse(length(.)==0,"None",paste0(.,collapse=" + "))}})  %>% unlist
```

## MVB experiment
```{r}
MVB_evolution_data <- read_csv("./data/evolution_experiment/curated_MVB_evolution_experiment_data.csv")
```
# Create annotated evolution dataset
```{r}
  MVB_evolution_data <- MVB_evolution_data %>% left_join(.,df %>% select(isolate_no,MVB,clade_I,PBP_any,OmpK36_L3_mutations,OmpK36GD,OmpK36TD,OmpK36_truncation_kleborate,OmpK36_non_syn,OmpK36_promoter_IS,tn4401_allele,KPC_present,KPC_type,KPC_plasmid,AA018_KPC,AA552_non_KPC))
MVB_evolution_data$category <- MVB_evolution_data %>% select(clade_I,KPC_type,OmpK36_L3_mutations,AA018_KPC,AA552_non_KPC) %>% apply(.,1,FUN=function(x){paste0(c(x["clade_I"],x["KPC_type"],names(x %>% subset(. %in% c(1)))),collapse=" + ")}) %>% gsub("OmpK36_L3_mutations",'Loop 3 insertion',.) %>% gsub("AA552_non_KPC","AA552 non-KPC plasmid",.) %>% gsub("AA018_KPC","AA018 KPC plasmid",.)  %>% gsub("+ No KPC +","",.) %>% gsub("\\+\\+","\\+",.)
MVB_evolution_data$category_simple <- ifelse(MVB_evolution_data$clade_I == "Clade II","Clade II without  mutation",ifelse(MVB_evolution_data$clade_I == "Clade I" & MVB_evolution_data$OmpK36_L3_mutations==1,"Clade I with Loop 3 insertion","Clade I without Loop 3 insertion" ))
```


# Isolate specific
```{r}  
MVB_evolution_data$category <- factor(MVB_evolution_data$category,levels = sort(MVB_evolution_data$category) %>% unique())
MVB_evolution_data <- MVB_evolution_data %>% arrange(clade_I,category) 
MVB_evolution_data$isolate_no <- factor(MVB_evolution_data$isolate_no,levels = MVB_evolution_data$isolate_no %>% unique) 
MVB_evolution_data$plasmid_type <- ifelse(MVB_evolution_data$AA018_KPC==1 & MVB_evolution_data$AA552_non_KPC==1, "AA018 with blaKPC + AA552 without blaKPC",
                                          ifelse(MVB_evolution_data$AA018_KPC==1 ,"AA018 with blaKPC",ifelse(MVB_evolution_data$AA552_non_KPC==1,"AA552 without blaKPC","Other blaKPC plasmid")))

categories <- c("#7684C0","maroon","lightgray",'black')
plasmid_type <- unique(MVB_evolution_data$plasmid_type) %>% sort

A <- ggplot(data=MVB_evolution_data,aes(y=isolate_no,x=MVB_ratio,fill=category_simple),alpha=0.85) + geom_boxplot(aes(color=plasmid_type),outliers = F)   + scale_color_manual(values = categories,breaks = plasmid_type, labels =gsub("blaKPC", "<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>", plasmid_type),name = "Plasmid type",guide=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FC4E07","pink","blue"),guide = guide_legend(ncol=1),name = "Status of the OmpK36 porin") + ggnewscale::new_scale_color() + geom_jitter(aes(y=isolate_no,x=MVB_ratio,color=over_LoD),width=0,height = 0.25)  + theme_bw_me + ylab(NULL) + xlab("Frequency of resistance") +
    scale_x_log10(
        limits = c(5e-13, 2e-6),
        breaks = c(1e-12, 1e-10, 1e-8,1e-6)
    )  + scale_color_manual(breaks = c(T,F),values = c("black","#A9A9A9"),labels = c("Over","Under"),name = "Limit of detection",guide=guide_legend(ncol=1)) + theme(legend.position='bottom',legend.title.position = 'top',axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),legend.title = element_text(size=12),legend.text = element_markdown(size=10),axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),axis.title.x = element_text(size=14))
A
```

# Isolate info

```{r}
info_matrix <- MVB_evolution_data %>% select(isolate_no,clade_I,OmpK36GD,KPC_type,KPC_plasmid,AA018_KPC,AA552_non_KPC) %>% distinct %>% arrange(rev(isolate_no)) 
info_matrix <- info_matrix %>% mutate(clade_I = recode(clade_I,"Clade I" = "I",
                              "Clade II" = "II"),
                              OmpK36GD = recode(OmpK36GD,`0`='',
                                                `1`="Present"),
                              AA018_KPC = recode(AA018_KPC,`0`='',
                                                `1`="Present"),
                              AA552_non_KPC = recode(AA552_non_KPC,`0`='',
                                                `1`="Present")) 
colnames(info_matrix) <- c("Isolate","Clade","GD insertion\nin OmpK36","blaKPC\nallele","blaKPC\nplasmid","AA018 blaKPC\nplasmid","AA552 non-blaKPC\nplasmid")

mytheme <- ttheme_minimal(core = list(fg_params = list(hjust=0, vjust = 0.5 ,x=0.1, fontsize=8.75),padding = unit(c(4.75, 2.5), "mm")),
                          colhead = list(fg_params = list(hjust=0, vjust = 0.5, x=0.1, fontsize=8.75, fontface="bold"),padding = unit(c(2.5, 2.5), "mm")),
                          rowhead=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0, x=0)))


B <- cowplot::plot_grid(tableGrob(info_matrix,rows = NULL,theme=mytheme)) 
```

# Binary heatmap
```{r}
info_matrix_bin <- MVB_evolution_data %>% select(isolate_no,clade_I,OmpK36GD,KPC_type,KPC_plasmid,AA018_KPC,AA552_non_KPC) %>% distinct %>% arrange(rev(isolate_no)) 
info_matrix_bin$clade_I_bin <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$clade_I=="Clade I",1,0)
info_matrix_bin$clade_I_bin <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$clade_I=="Clade I",1,0)
info_matrix_bin$KPC3 <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$KPC_type=="KPC-3",1,0)
info_matrix_bin$KPC2 <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$KPC_type=="KPC-2",1,0)
info_matrix_bin$AA018 <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$KPC_plasmid=="AA018_KPC",1,0)
info_matrix_bin$AA275 <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$KPC_plasmid=="AA275_KPC",1,0) 
info_matrix_bin$Other_KPC <- ifelse(info_matrix_bin$KPC_plasmid %in% c('AA356_KPC','AD548_KPC','AA274_KPC','AA357_KPC',"AA275_KPC"),1,0)

info_matrix_bin_mat <- info_matrix_bin %>% select(isolate_no,clade_I_bin,KPC2,OmpK36GD,AA018,AA552_non_KPC,Other_KPC,KPC3)
info_matrix_bin_mat <- as.data.frame(info_matrix_bin_mat)
rownames(info_matrix_bin_mat) <- info_matrix_bin_mat$isolate_no
info_matrix_bin_mat <- info_matrix_bin_mat %>% select(-isolate_no)
colnames(info_matrix_bin_mat) <- c("Clade I","KPC-2","GD insertion in OmpK36","AA018 KPC plasmid","AA552 non-KPC plasmid","Other KPC plasmid","KPC-3")
matrix_viz <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(info_matrix_bin_mat,cluster_rows = F,cluster_columns = F,col = c(`1`='black',`0`='white'),column_names_side ='bottom',show_row_names = T,row_names_side = 'left',
        heatmap_legend_param = list(
            title = "Presence",      
            at = c(1, 0),            
            labels = c("Yes", "No")  
        ),height = unit(11.5,"cm"),
        rect_gp = gpar(col = NA))

p2 = grid.grabExpr(draw(matrix_viz))
```

